name: avibe
description: Make your computer a home for your AI partner. Avibe is the local-first Agent OS: Vibey, its built-in AI partner, works out of the box, and Claude Code, Codex & OpenCode run unchanged beside it — reach them from your browser, phone, or any chat app.
